controls.requirement: Atomic registration binds one funded entry to one player/event. Race duplicate requests, last seat and registration closure.
Split total entry into disclosed prize, bounty and fee components. Verify all supported prices and promotional entries.
Fund guarantees/overlays from an approved bank. Total committed prizes must fit actual funding before obligations mature.
Give each re-entry a distinct identity; enforce eliminated status, limits and deadline. Never mistake retries for another entry.
Process rebuy/add-on eligibility and funding atomically, with tournament chips separate from spendable cash.
Unregister/refund according to entry provenance and policy. Race refund with tournament start and satellite transfer.
Freeze the final payout ladder at the disclosed cutoff; distribute residual units once and store the resulting amounts.
Persist elimination rank from authoritative hands. Test same-hand ties, simultaneous tables and final-table transitions.
Create unique finishing obligations and pay cumulative deltas once. Test early payouts and final incremental awards.
Fund extra bubble protection separately or include its disclosed reserve before binding the ladder. Never overcommit the pool.
Drain correct prize/bounty/fee sub-balances at completion; leave display history intact and preserve unpaid debt.
Expose paid, partially paid and owed states in results and player statements. Tournament completed must not imply all paid.
Use one durable tournament clock and level definition across all tables. Restart must restore elapsed active-play time.
controls.evidence: Break Clock Recovery Correction in the companion report

controls.requirement: Snapshot level/blinds at hand creation; advance only the next eligible hand when a level boundary occurs mid-hand.
Define registration wall time separately from blind time and maintenance extensions. Test daylight saving and UTC conversion.
Publish break cadence, duration and exceptions. Track requested, draining, on-break and resumed states explicitly.
Finish active hands before a tournament break begins; release participating tables using one authoritative deadline.
Keep maintenance, hand-for-hand, deal discussion and operator pauses independently owned. One resume cannot clear another.
Transfer all applicable deadlines across the approved maintenance freeze. No hidden time-bank, rebuy or offer expiry.
Balance tables with the published seat-selection rule. Transfer scoring stacks once and preserve in-progress hands.
Break tables and form the final table without missing/duplicating players. Test moves alongside elimination and reconnect.
Hand-for-hand uses a shared hand epoch and barrier. Compare simultaneous eliminations under the chosen rank policy.
Tournament sit-outs still follow tournament blinds/antes policy. Cash sit-out rules must not remove tournament obligations.
Test missed scheduler ticks, engine failover and long-running hands at :53/:55/:00 without restarting active settlement.
Start a full SNG once under concurrent final-seat joins. All entrants must be funded before the start commits.
Resolve last-seat join versus unregister atomically. Never start with a refunded entrant or strand an unseated buy-in.
Define seating, blinds, time banks and payouts for each SNG size, including heads-up and special payout formats.
Use the same escrow/obligation contract as MTTs, with separate format rules rather than duplicate payment implementations.
Close SNG/heads-up fee escrow correctly and retain prize display history. Completed events must have explained residuals.
Persist one Spin draw, probability table version and entrants before reveal. Replay and failover cannot reroll.
controls.evidence: Atomic Spin Funding And Frozen Rule Receipt in the companion report

controls.requirement: Fund the selected Spin payout with net entries plus reserve transfer. Fees cannot be counted as prize funding twice.
controls.evidence: Atomic Spin Funding And Frozen Rule Receipt in the companion report

controls.requirement: Reveal multiplier/prize before the first deal and action timer. All participants must receive the same stored result.
Apply multiplier-specific payout places, starting stack and levels. Test every probability tier, not only the common result.
controls.evidence: Atomic Spin Funding And Frozen Rule Receipt in the companion report

controls.requirement: Audit reserve contributions, draws, odds and expected cost. Verify peak payout exposure against approved funding policy.
Define Spin/SNG cancellation before draw, after reveal and after play begins. Avoid double refunds or reserve releases.
Implement heads-up button/action order and simultaneous-bustout rules consistently across engine, history and displayed payouts.
Keep bounty funding separate from finishing prizes and rake. Reconcile entry splits, carried bounties and paid rewards.
Award eliminations by relevant-pot eligibility, including side pots, tied winners and split-pot variants.
PKO cash portion plus carried portion equals the eliminated bounty. Resolve final winner own-bounty treatment explicitly.
Mystery activation follows the approved rebuy/add-on cutoff. A break alone must not enable early awards.
Generate and fund the complete mystery reward inventory. Draw without replacement with one key per entitlement.
Update remaining mystery rewards and public winners once. Animation replay must not redraw, reorder or repay.
Transfer satellite seat value from its funded pool into target escrow exactly once; retain both event identities.
Apply Smarter cash treatment for duplicate seats, valid unregisters and cancelled targets. Do not introduce unapproved tickets.
Resolve target registration closure and concurrent target entries atomically with seat award or approved cash alternative.
Fund satellite seat guarantees and leftover awards explicitly. Test fields smaller than advertised seat count.
Publish and enforce deals, shootouts, phased events and equal-prize stopping rules only where those formats are offered.
Version cancellation treatment for already-paid bounties, guarantees and seat transfers. Preserve prior legitimate awards.
Replay tournament cancellation after some minimum-cash awards have posted. Each player receives only the remaining contractual entitlement.
Concurrent final SNG registrations and an unregister select one entrant set, one startup and exactly funded entries.
Recover a Spin after its draw commits but before the spinner appears. Preserve multiplier, payout ladder, starting stack and rule version.
controls.evidence: Atomic Spin Funding And Frozen Rule Receipt in the companion report

controls.requirement: Cancellation races a persisted Spin draw. Apply the approved pre-draw/post-draw policy without silently discarding a funded high multiplier.
Test paid places plus bubble refund, fee, bounty and guarantee against independently funded escrow before publishing the prize ladder.
Blind expiry, registration closure, :53 drain and :55 maintenance overlap a long hand: assigned forced bets stay fixed; each clock follows its documented policy.
Hand-for-hand completion arrives twice or late while a table breaks. One batch completes against the correct authoritative table set.
Reverse delivery order for simultaneous bubble bustouts; rank from the versioned synchronized-hand rule, never arrival order.
Bustout, re-entry cutoff and prize finalization race: all three agree on one accepted entry count and funded pool.
Table balancing races blind posting and disconnect: player occupies one seat, stack transfers once, and forced bets are not duplicated.
